description: This PHP source file defines the Drupal migrate process plugin 'MenuLinkParent', which determines the parent of a menu link during migration. It includes class definition, methods for constructing the plugin, and logic for identifying parent menu links by ID or properties.

classes.name: MenuLinkParent
classes.description: A Drupal migrate process plugin that determines the parent menu link for migration, either by ID or by menu name and link path.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with configuration, services, and migration context.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Determines and returns the parent menu link plugin ID based on source data, or throws exception if not found.
